onboarding.consent.intro: Kumiho is an unofficial desktop client for the VPN proxy included with a Firefox account. Please read this before you continue.
onboarding.consent.item.signs_in: It signs in with your Firefox account and stores the resulting sign-in tokens on this PC. It never stores your password.
onboarding.consent.item.tunnel: It carries your traffic through Mozilla's servers using an HTTP/2 tunnel.
onboarding.consent.item.udp: The tunnel carries TCP and DNS only. Non-DNS UDP traffic (some games, video calls, and QUIC/HTTP3) is blocked on purpose, so apps either fall back to TCP or stop working.
onboarding.consent.item.unofficial: Kumiho is not affiliated with or endorsed by Mozilla. Using an unofficial client is a gray area under Mozilla's terms of service.
onboarding.consent.item.kill_switch: While the tunnel is up, the kill switch can block traffic that tries to leave outside it.
onboarding.consent.item.as_is: Kumiho is provided as is; review the code before trusting it with your account.
onboarding.consent.tick: Tick "I understand" below to unlock Continue.
onboarding.language.label: Language
onboarding.language.save_failed: The language could not be saved.
onboarding.login.choice_body: Sign in with the Firefox account that has the VPN. Continue in your browser (recommended), or use your account password.
onboarding.login.email_body: Sign in with the Firefox account that has the VPN. Kumiho stores the sign-in tokens on this PC, never your password.
onboarding.login.code_body: Enter the verification code from the email Mozilla sent you.
onboarding.login.link_body: Check your email and open the Mozilla sign-in link, then choose Continue with the code empty to finish signing in.
onboarding.login.signed_body: Kumiho already has a signed-in Firefox account. Choose Continue to finish setting up, or sign out to use a different account.
onboarding.login.waiting_body: Finish signing in in your browser. The browser lands on a Firefox Accounts success page; paste the complete URL from its address bar.
onboarding.login.totp_body: Enter the code from your authenticator app.
onboarding.login.unblock_body: Enter the unblock code Mozilla emailed you.
onboarding.login.redirect_required: Paste the complete redirect URL from the browser.
onboarding.login.redirect_failed: Could not finish sign-in with that URL.
onboarding.login.browser_waiting_status: Waiting for sign-in in your browser...
onboarding.login.sign_out_detail: The stored sign-in tokens are cleared and the tunnel disconnects.
onboarding.login.sign_out_revoke: Kumiho will also try to revoke its Mozilla sign-in; local sign-out completes offline.
onboarding.health.body: Kumiho checked this PC. Fix anything marked Failed before connecting; warnings are usually fine.
onboarding.health.summary.failed: {checks}: {failed} failed, {warnings} — fix the failed checks before connecting
onboarding.autoconnect.body: Kumiho can connect automatically whenever it starts. You can change this later in Settings.
onboarding.autoconnect.label: Autoconnect
onboarding.finish.body: Kumiho is ready. Press Connect on the Dashboard to start the tunnel.
onboarding.finish.failed: Could not finish setup. Check the details and try again.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Check the details and try again.
error.bad_request: The sign-in details were not accepted. Check them and try again.
error.region_blocked: Mozilla's sign-in hosts are blocked here. Open the Blocked region guide.
error.bootstrap_required: A connection is needed to finish. Try again.
error.forbidden: Mozilla refused this sign-in. Try again or use another method.
error.internal: Kumiho hit an internal error. Try again, and check the logs if it repeats.
error.not_implemented: This sign-in method is not available in this build.
error.unsupported_setting: This setting is not supported by this daemon.
dashboard.proxy_hint: Keep system routing untouched; SOCKS5 proxy only.
dashboard.kill_switch_hint: Last keeps the value currently in effect.
locations.fastest_empty_detail: Run Ping all to enable Fastest
notice.dashboard.prepare.done: Prepared. Turn off the other VPN, then connect.
